title: Execute in-place fixed-grid half-source ADD on two tapes
body:
The selected call000 raw2 ADD reference in PR2370 leaves physical bit operations and cleanup explicit. This package supplies one prepared fixed-grid boundary: a width-independent two-tape controller updates an arbitrary dirty signed target by plus or minus half an even signed source, preserves the complete source and exterior cells, and returns both heads in exactly **2n+3 unit-head transitions** for every positive width n.

The machine uses four symbols and a 224-entry table, with no work tape, numeric address, width counter or seek instruction. Odd sources reject before any write. Even sources always produce the correct modular answer; signed exactness retains an explicit no-overflow premise. The opposite orientation restores the original target bits. Finite control terminates in a prescribed done state; this is endpoint invertibility, not a locally reversible transition relation.

The all-length proof uses the arithmetic sign-extension and full-adder invariants, then charges every rewind and marker transition. Exact replay covers 87,380 exhaustive cases through width 8, 1,601,988 transitions, 255 odd-source rejections, 192 translated large-word cases through width 1024, 158 dirty inverse round trips and eight semantic/premise controls. Registered CPython 3.12.7 primary and Git-free optimized integrity checks passed, including source/snapshot corruption and typed receipt rejection. A separate Codex agent read the proof/code and independently replayed the optimized scientific check with no blockers.

PR2370's literal read/halve/add/write sequence and component equation are authenticated from unchanged sources. Its visible accumulator is not reproduced: the claimed refinement concerns the projected memory equation. PR2439's paid variable-exponent fresh-output half adder and PR1869's generic signed addition remain credited. This package supplies a different in-place fixed-grid interface and makes no generic arithmetic novelty or performance comparison claim.

Marked equal-width streams, separate tapes, common grid/chart, divisibility and headroom are caller conditions. Marker installation, source/target acquisition, family routing, full reference-state correspondence and selected global precision/hosting remain open. Each Gaussian component needs its own paid invocation. No Lean proof, full physical compiler, supplier admission, selected frontier change or new kappa is claimed.

Canonical main is unchanged at `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision 4. The 768-PR/1,232-Discussion complete snapshot was supplemented with current predecessor-head checks and the 100 latest updated open PRs. Exact coverage, timestamps and limitations are in TASK.json/OVERLAP.json. No hosted CI or independent human review is claimed.

Credit James Chang and the retained PR2370/2439/1869 machine/reference lineage, DreamingOfClouds PR509/516, Gareth Davidson PR1309, bank routing and generic multitape contributors. New controller, proof, checks and documentation by ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.

Replay: `python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/fixed-grid-half-add`.
